# Branch naming convention

```
<type>/<mod>-<desc>
```

- `type`: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `chore`, `refactor`
- `mod`: the mod folder the change touches (`git-graph`, `todo-band`). Use `repo` for changes outside a mod.
- `desc`: a short kebab-case summary

Examples: `feat/git-graph-ui-improvements`, `fix/todo-band-scratchpad-path`, `chore/repo-ci`
